dedup.scope: The three already-counted claims of this source, the public identity index, the retired-claims record and the current worklist were searched with the object names of this claim (central series, Z(u), centre of the super Yangian, antipode, Berezinian, RTT); only the independent statement named in the counted unit is counted.

compared.difference: Same source, different proposition: the counted public unit of doi:10.3842/SIGMA.2020.112 is Theorem 2.8 (label T18, statement at source lines 849-850 with the counted proof at 844-850), the isomorphism of the enveloping algebra of the current Lie superalgebra with the associated graded Yangian, whose obligation is injectivity of the current-algebra map. The present card counts Proposition 3.1 (label zu, source lines 877-886) with its proof at 888-977, the construction of the central series Z(u) and the two RTT-type identities it satisfies; it is a different proposition in a later section and it asserts centrality of a specific series, not an associated-graded isomorphism.

compared.kind: prepared neighbour from the same source
compared.difference: That card counts Theorem 3.6 (label Z, source lines 1122-1126 with its proof at 1346-1372), the free generation of the centre by the coefficients of Z(u); its own difficulty reason states that centrality alone does not give all central elements or independence, and it keeps source lines 863-1120 only as retained proof foundation. The present card counts that construction-and-centrality proposition, which no counted claim of any neighbour asserts.

compared.kind: prepared neighbour from the same source
compared.difference: That card counts Theorem 4.1 (label BZ, source lines 1392-1394), the quantum Berezinian shift identity B(u+1) = Z(u)B(u); the counted statement here is the earlier existence and centrality of the series Z(u) with its two RTT-type identities, which the Berezinian card keeps only as retained foundation (source lines 169-1120).

compared.difference: reference/public-items.jsonl has no item containing Berezinian or central series and no item about the centre of a Yangian of a general linear Lie superalgebra. The only super-Yangian neighbour is 194655 (Super Yangians in characteristic 2, claim arxiv:2602.13603:theorem-center-zsuper-g), which works in characteristic 2 with current enveloping algebras and a p-centre, and has neither the series Z(u) in u^{-1} nor the complex RTT setting of this claim. The antipode neighbours (1712, 2009, 2013, 183743, 198567, 202030) are about Hopf monoids, Galois extensions and Steenrod-algebra antipodes and share no object.
